name: LoyalFans
summary: All-in-one creator platform combining monthly feeds, clip stores, live streams, and direct one-on-one video calls—popular with fetish and pro performers.
ranking_rationale: Strong feature breadth—especially native one-on-one video calls and fetish-friendly moderation—though a smaller creator base than OnlyFans or Fansly.

pricing.model: Per-creator subscriptions + clip store, live streams & paid video calls
pricing.free_tier: Free account creation; creator feeds and calls priced individually
pricing.notes: Subscriptions, video-call per-minute rates, and store clips are set by each creator.
